description: This file implements a custom guardrail system for integrating Bedrock guardrails with a language model framework, including request/response formatting, API interaction, content redaction, masking, and guardrail enforcement logic within a larger LLM proxy environment.

classes.name: GuardrailMessageFilterResult
classes.description: A NamedTuple used to hold the results of filtering messages for guardrail processing, including payload messages, original messages, and target indices.

classes.name: BedrockGuardrail
classes.description: A class that implements a custom guardrail for Bedrock, handling request/response formatting, API interaction, masking, redaction, and guardrail logic within the proxy framework.

methods.name: dict _redact_pii_matches(response_json: dict)
methods.description: Deepcopies and redacts PII matches in a response JSON, replacing matches with '[REDACTED]'.
